paragraphs: Pip is very dirty today. He runs in the garden. Tom and Lily go with him to the bathroom. "Pip, do you want a bath?" asks Tom. Lily has a red and white paper boat. "Look at my boat, Pip!" says Lily. "Woof!" says Pip. Pip does not want a bath. He sits behind the door.

Tom puts water in the bath. Lily puts the paper boat in the water. Pip jumps in the bath too. Water is on the floor. The paper boat is not good now. "Oh no!" says Lily. "My boat!" "Paper is not for the bath," says Tom. Lily is sad.

Tom has a big towel. Pip is clean now. He is happy. He stands on the mat. Lily gets the boat from the water. "I can make a new boat," she says. She puts the boat on her bed. Pip comes to the bed. He sleeps next to the boat. "Good night, Pip," says Lily.
text.summary: Pip is dirty, so Tom and Lily give him a bath. Lily's paper boat is not good in the water, and she puts it on her bed.
